design.model_selection_reason: Chosen from official architecture, capacity and resolution before any S inference or BDD-specific model search. No trial of competing models.

license.scope: Regents/BAIR BDD data and labels, research/educational/not-for-profit use; commercial limitations remain.

unscored_category_reason.traffic sign: BDD generic signs do not correspond to COCO stop-sign class; retained and counted separately, never treated as road-user ground truth.

inference.resize: Rust image::Triangle into uint8, an explicit approximation of upstream OpenCV INTER_LINEAR
inference.pixels: raw BGR, top-left letterbox114, CHWfloat32; no mean/std or /255
inference.decoding: raw grid heads strides8/16/32, sigmoid objectness/classes already applied
inference.selection: argmax class per grid then classwise NMS; RustDriving policy, not exact upstream multiclass demo

evaluation.gate_role: Small viewed diagnostic quality gate; cannot establish independent automotive generalization even if passed.

limits: Same eight BDD frames were previously viewed; S model itself not selected by their scores.
COCO-pretrained artifact and upstream exposure do not establish fresh driving-domain generalization.
No metric depth, camera extrinsics, vehicle controls or signal-color inference.
CPU timings are measurements of this machine, not real-time guarantees.
Source release/Apache license provenance is retained; no separately stated weight license or publisher checksum was found.
